fixes.fix: round(Float) without ndigits returned a Float instead of an int
fixes.why: round(x) on a float must return int per Python semantics; snapshot returned 2.0 (breaks e.g. indexing).

fixes.fix: Integer ** negative exponent silently truncated to Integer (2 ** -1 == 0)
fixes.why: Wrong numeric result: doc['i'] ** -1 gave 0 instead of 0.5.

fixes.fix: Overlong decimal integer parsed as an infinite float instead of rejected
fixes.why: An integer literal silently became float inf (data corruption / spec violation).
fixes.upstream_commit: b48c094 reject overlong decimal integer instead of coercing to inf (#538)

fixes.fix: Surrogate code points accepted in \U escapes
fixes.why: TOML requires Unicode scalar values; surrogates produce unencodable strings.
fixes.upstream_commit: b1399c3 reject surrogate code points in \U unicode escapes (#493)

fixes.fix: escape_string quadratic (s[i:] copy at every position)
fixes.why: Pathological slowness: escaping a 600k-char string took >5s on snapshot; still unfixed upstream.

fixes.fix: String.__add__ spliced unescaped text into the raw literal (and could not switch from literal to basic)
fixes.why: Appending a quote/backslash produced invalid TOML output.
fixes.upstream_commit: 61941de Escape content appended to a String via __add__ (#612)

fixes.fix: Date/Time constructed directly (no raw) rendered as empty string
fixes.why: doc['d'] = Date(2020,1,2) emitted 'd = ' (invalid TOML).

fixes.fix: item(datetime) replaced every '+00:00' substring with 'Z', garbling offsets like +00:00:30
fixes.why: Produced garbled '...Z:30' output for second-resolution offsets (edge case but wrong output).

fixes.fix: Array.__delitem__ with slices computed wrong indices (negative/omitted bounds, negative steps)
fixes.why: del a[-2:] etc. deleted the wrong rendered elements, desyncing value and output.
fixes.upstream_commit: 8c30fc1 Fix Array.__delitem__ corrupting rendered output on slice deletion (#599)

fixes.fix: Array slice assignment mutated the list before raising ValueError
fixes.why: Left the array in an inconsistent state after a rejected operation.
fixes.upstream_commit: 4b38bec fix: reject array slice assignment before mutation (#600)

fixes.fix: Array.sort() sorted the list but not the rendered body
fixes.why: After sort(), as_string() still emitted the old order (value/render desync).

fixes.fix: Array.append reindexed the whole array each time (quadratic)
fixes.why: Appending 20k values took >5s on snapshot (pathological slowness).

fixes.fix: AoT.__setitem__ updated _body but not the underlying list
fixes.why: ==, list(), json.dumps saw stale values after aot[i] = ...

fixes.fix: AoT.insert looked at the wrong neighbour (index+1) when adding a newline to the following table
fixes.why: Only affects a cosmetic blank line; regression test passes on snapshot and no observable difference found.

fixes.fix: Container.copy() did not copy _table_keys (plus guard for empty _table_keys)
fixes.why: Appending an out-of-order table to a copied document raised IndexError.

fixes.fix: Replacing a table with a plain value inserted it into the preceding table's region
fixes.why: On round-trip the key became a child of the previous table (data corruption).
fixes.upstream_commit: f9b4b22 Move a value replacing a table out of the table region (#506)

fixes.fix: _replace_at mishandled dotted-key tables (value->table placed before dotted keys; replacing a dotted table kept dotted key and captured siblings)
fixes.why: Following dotted/inline siblings were swallowed into the new [header] or prefixes duplicated on round-trip.
fixes.upstream_commit: ee4eedb Fix duplicated prefix and captured sibling when replacing a dotted key with a table (#526); 67d3e86 Fix array of tables replacing a dotted key swallowing the next sibling (#549)

fixes.fix: Adding a table/AoT/super table to a table defined by dotted keys rendered a [header] that captured following key/values
fixes.why: doc['tool']['black'] = {...} after 'tool.poetry.name' made 'other = 1' re-nest under tool.black (data corruption); still broken upstream.

fixes.fix: Container._insert_at / _get_last_index_before_table scanned the whole map/body per insertion (quadratic appends)
fixes.why: Appending 10k keys to a document with a table took >5s on snapshot.

fixes.fix: OutOfOrderTableProxy could not be pickled/copied (default dict reduction replayed __setitem__ on half-initialized proxy)
fixes.why: pickle/copy raised AttributeError and deepcopy could write into the shared document.

fixes.fix: InlineTable.append with a multi-part (dotted) Key stored the entry under an empty key
fixes.why: Rendered output failed to re-parse (EmptyKeyError).

fixes.fix: Mutating a dotted-key subtable inside an inline table produced corrupt output
fixes.why: {c.d.e = 2} + new key rendered as 'c.d.e = 2d.f = 3' (invalid TOML).
fixes.upstream_commit: a076a6a Fix corrupt output when adding to a dotted key inside an inline table (#500)

fixes.fix: InlineTable.as_string quadratic tail scans per comma
fixes.why: Rendering a 20k-key inline table took >5s on snapshot.
fixes.upstream_commit: 86f4562 Render inline tables in O(n) instead of O(n^2) (#525)

fixes.fix: InlineTable pickle/deepcopy dropped the _new flag, changing separators
fixes.why: Copy rendered '{x = 1,y = 2}' instead of '{x = 1, y = 2}': still valid TOML, formatting-only difference.

fixes.fix: dumps(sort_keys=True) did not sort keys of a Table argument or nested tables
fixes.why: sort_keys=True left a table's keys unsorted, contrary to the documented option.

fixes.fix: Parser string accumulation via repeated str += (claimed quadratic)
fixes.why: Regression test passes on snapshot; measured ~2x constant-factor speedup with the same scaling, not a complexity fix.
fixes.upstream_commit: 4623b45 Bulk-scan single-line string bodies (#491) / c468c97 Bulk-scan multiline string bodies (#518) (perf rewrites of same loop)
